name: devai-verify
description: Independent read-only review of a DEVAI change, docs coherence, or release candidate against its evidence. Use for "review this change", "is the RC coherent", or when a campaign's review step runs.

change.description: Review a bounded change and its focused evidence, ending the reply with one review verdict document in the shape law/schemas/review-verdict.schema.json declares.

docs-coherence.description: Compare named documents and report contradictions or stale references.

rc.description: Verify the complete local RC evidence population.
